key_points_missing: CSDR Article 39(2) (each system defines its own moments of entry/irrevocability) is not stated. The bundle contains no CSDR passage, so the answer was right not to assert it from memory; but it also does not name the EU-law basis as an unanswerable part / missing source, relying instead on a labelled reasoned inference from the Milan text ('the Settlement System', Legislative Decree 210/2001, Monte Titoli mandate, library scoping to entity Milan) and on Copenhagen's own rulebook. All points supportable from the bundle are present.
reason: The answer declines to extend Article 72 and does not apply Milan rules to Copenhagen: it quotes Article 72(2) faithfully ('Settlement Instructions cannot be revoked by a participant or a third party from the time of their matching in T2S (SF2), without prejudice to the bilateral cancellation of settlement Instructions provided for under Article 70 (2)') as a provision of Monte Titoli's Service Regulations, and sets against it Copenhagen's own moments from Part 4: §11.6.7 (entry 'declared compliant with the technical rules of T2S by VP' for pre-matched orders, 'by the T2S platform' otherwise), §11.7.1 ('status “Matched” on the T2S platform ... cannot unilaterally be cancelled or revoked (the Moment of Irrevocability) ... “Hold & Release” may, however, be applied ... bilaterally agree to cancel ... until settlement'), §11.8.2.1 ('as from the account entry (credit) of the securities on the receiving Settlement Participant’s Securities Account on the T2S platform'), and §§4.3, 5.3.1, 6.2.1.1 for the VP route. Every locator (PDF 50–51 printed 49–50; PDF 7–9; PDF 14–17; PDF 3–4; UDFS PDF 267–271, 303–304), version (26 January 2026; Part 4 1 May 2025 / Version 13; R2026.JUN), review date (2026-09-13 Milan and UDFS, 2026-09-14 Copenhagen) and LIMITATION line (Italian authoritative translation; 'Danish law governs the VP system and no authoritative-language statement was reviewed'; 'No insolvency runbook, legal opinion or unreviewed Article 72 remainder admitted'; VP-route scope; outdated UHB URL; pre-match entry moments; User Guidelines not in library) is carried correctly, and inferences and explanations are labelled. Completeness is partial only because the hidden CSDR Article 39(2) point, for which the bundle offered no passage, is neither stated nor flagged as a missing source.
